# Editable sources of the README pictures

Generated by `tools/release` (media step) for BMM 1.0.4.

- `hero.svg`: the semi-3D banner, layered (background and grid, the three windows and Tasky as raster layers drawn in perspective, linked from `../layers/hero.*.png`, then the wordmark, tagline and version).
- `hero-flat.svg`: the flat banner of earlier releases (`../hero-flat.png`), its screenshots linked from `../`.
- `<name>.svg`: each screenshot as two layers, *screenshot* and *Tasky*, linked from `../layers/`.

Layered **PSD** files of every picture (cards, heroes, screenshots), self-contained, with a README listing their layers, are in `Release/<version>/media/source/psd/` (not committed).
